❯ itu untuk semua pair dan semua sumber, bukan gitu doang (karena itu cuma      
  fondasi) kita mau sekelas James simmons dan citadel renaissance. yang ini     
  maksudku :                                                                    
                                                                                
  ---                                                                           
                                                                                
  🥇 GOLD                                                                       
                                                                                
  GC1! ↔ XAUUSD                                                                 
                                                                                
  GC1! = Gold futures (CME, duit gede main sini)                                
                                                                                
  XAUUSD = spot / CFD (retail)                                                  
                                                                                
                                                                                
  👉 Analisa pakai GC1!                                                         
  👉 Entry bisa di XAUUSD                                                       
                                                                                
  Kalau GC1! break high duluan → spot biasanya nyusul.                          
                                                                                
                                                                                
  ---                                                                           
                                                                                
  🥈 SILVER                                                                     
                                                                                
  SI1! ↔ XAGUSD                                                                 
                                                                                
                                                                                
  Gold & Silver biasanya searah.                                                
  Kalau gold naik tapi silver nggak ikut → hati-hati, bisa fake move.           
                                                                                
                                                                                
  ---                                                                           
                                                                                
  💵 FOREX (Futures vs Spot)                                                    
                                                                                
  Futures    Spot Pair                                                          
                                                                                
  6E1!    EURUSD                                                                
  6B1!    GBPUSD                                                                
  6J1!    USDJPY                                                                
  6A1!    AUDUSD                                                                
  6C1!    USDCAD                                                                
  6S1!    USDCHF                                                                
                                                                                
                                                                                
  👉 Futures = versi asli institusi                                             
  👉 Spot = versi broker                                                        
                                                                                
  Contoh: 6E1! break structure → EURUSD biasanya ikut.                          
                                                                                
                                                                                
  ---                                                                           
                                                                                
  💲 DXY (Dollar Index)                                                         
                                                                                
  DXY = kekuatan USD terhadap banyak mata uang.                                 
                                                                                
  Kalau DXY naik:                                                               
                                                                                
  EURUSD turun                                                                  
                                                                                
  GBPUSD turun                                                                  
                                                                                
  XAUUSD turun                                                                  
                                                                                
  BTC turun (biasanya)                                                          
                                                                                
                                                                                
  Kalau DXY turun:                                                              
                                                                                
  Gold naik                                                                     
                                                                                
  Indices naik                                                                  
                                                                                
  Crypto naik                                                                   
                                                                                
                                                                                
  Dollar itu kayak “bos uang dunia”.                                            
                                                                                
                                                                                
  ---                                                                           
                                                                                
  📈 INDICES                                                                    
                                                                                
  Futures    CFD                                                                
                                                                                
  ES1!    US500                                                                 
  NQ1!    NAS100                                                                
  YM1!    US30                                                                  
                                                                                
                                                                                
  Kalau NQ dan ES beda arah → ada divergensi.                                   
                                                                                
                                                                                
  ---                                                                           
                                                                                
  🏦 BONDS                                                                      
                                                                                
  ZB1! = 30Y Bond                                                               
                                                                                
  ZN1! = 10Y Bond                                                               
                                                                                
                                                                                
  Kalau bond naik → orang cari aman.                                            
  Biasanya saham turun.                                                         
                                                                                
                                                                                
  ---                                                                           
                                                                                
  ₿ CRYPTO                                                                      
                                                                                
  BTC1! ↔ BTCUSD                                                                
                                                                                
  ETH1! ↔ ETHUSD                                                                
                                                                                
                                                                                
  Futures duluan gerak → spot nyusul.                                           
                                                                                
                                                                                
  ---                                                                           
                                                                                
  🔥 SAFE HAVEN & RISK OFF (Versi Warung Kopi)                                  
                                                                                
  Bayangin ekonomi kayak cuaca.                                                 
                                                                                
  ☀️ Risk On                                                                    
                                                                                
  Cuaca cerah. Orang berani ambil risiko.                                       
                                                                                
  Uang masuk ke:                                                                
                                                                                
  Saham                                                                         
                                                                                
  Crypto                                                                        
                                                                                
  AUD, NZD                                                                      
                                                                                
                                                                                
  Gold biasanya biasa aja atau turun.                                           
                                                                                
                                                                                
  ---                                                                           
                                                                                
  🌧 Risk Off                                                                    
                                                                                
  Cuaca badai. Perang, krisis, ekonomi jelek.                                   
                                                                                
  Orang lari ke tempat aman.                                                    
                                                                                
  Uang masuk ke:                                                                
                                                                                
  Gold                                                                          
                                                                                
  USD                                                                           
                                                                                
  Bonds (ZB1!)                                                                  
                                                                                
                                                                                
  Itu namanya safe haven (tempat berlindung).                                   
                                                                                
  Kayak kalau ada rusuh, orang nggak beli motor racing, mereka simpan emas.     
                                                                                
  Sederhana.                                                                    
                                                                                
                                                                                
  ---                                                                           
                                                                                
  📊 COT DATA (Commitment of Traders)                                           
                                                                                
  COT = laporan posisi trader besar.                                            
                                                                                
  Dirilis tiap minggu (Jumat malam).                                            
                                                                                
  Ada 3 pemain utama:                                                           
                                                                                
  1️⃣ Commercial                                                                 
                                                                                
  Perusahaan besar (hedging). Biasanya paling pintar. Kalau mereka akumulasi    
  diam-diam, itu penting.                                                       
                                                                                
  2️⃣ Non-Commercial (Managed Money)                                             
                                                                                
  Hedge fund. Ini yang sering trending.                                         
                                                                                
  Kalau mereka ekstrem buy semua, hati-hati bisa reversal.                      
                                                                                
  3️⃣ Non-Reportable                                                             
                                                                                
  Retail kecil.                                                                 
                                                                                
  Biasanya nggak terlalu berpengaruh.                                           
                                                                                
                                                                                
  ---                                                                           
                                                                                
  Cara baca gampangnya                                                          
                                                                                
  Kalau: Managed Money terlalu banyak BUY                                       
  → Market bisa sudah di atas, siap koreksi.                                    
                                                                                
  Kalau: Commercial net buy besar                                               
  → Bisa ada akumulasi bawah.                                                   
                                                                                
  COT bukan buat entry harian.                                                  
  COT buat baca posisi besar jangka menengah.                                   
                                                                                
                                                                                
  ---                                                                           
                                                                                
  🔑 Ringkasan Simpel                                                           
                                                                                
  Gold trader minimal pantau:                                                   
                                                                                
  GC1!                                                                          
                                                                                
  XAUUSD                                                                        
                                                                                
  DXY                                                                           
                                                                                
  ZB1!                                                                          
                                                                                
  NQ1!                                                                          
                                                                                
                                                                                
  Kalau: DXY naik + Bond naik                                                   
  → Risk off kuat.                                                              
                                                                                
  Kalau: DXY turun + Index naik                                                 
  → Risk on.

       94 -### DXY Correlation                                           
       59 +```python                                                     
       60 +# Time-shifted cross-correlation untuk setiap pair            
       61 +# Window: 30, 60, 120 candles                                 
       62 +# Lag: -20 sampai +20 candles                                 
       63 +# Output: siapa yang lead, siapa yang lag, confidence level   
       64  
       96 -| DXY | EURUSD | GBPUSD | XAUUSD | BTC | Indices |            
       97 -|-----|--------|--------|--------|-----|---------|            
       98 -| Naik | ↓ | ↓ | ↓ | ↓ | ↓ |                                  
       99 -| Turun | ↑ | ↑ | ↑ | ↑ | ↑ |                                 
       65 +def measure_lead_lag(asset_a_prices, asset_b_prices, max_lag=2
          +0):                                                           
       66 +    correlations = []                                         
       67 +    for lag in range(-max_lag, max_lag + 1):                  
       68 +        shifted = shift(asset_b_prices, lag)                  
       69 +        corr = pearson_corr(asset_a_prices, shifted)          
       70 +        correlations.append((lag, corr))                      
       71 +    best_lag = max(correlations, key=lambda x: x[1])          
       72 +    return {                                                  
       73 +        "lead_asset": "A" if best_lag[0] < 0 else "B",        
       74 +        "lag": abs(best_lag[0]),                              
       75 +        "confidence": abs(best_lag[1]),                       
       76 +    }                                                         
       77 +```

● Bayangin QNA kayak pabrik mobil otomatis. Ada ban, mesin, cat — semua masuk ke
  conveyor belt, keluar jadi mobil jadi.

  Conveyor belt QNA = run_once() di hedge_fund/portfolio/main.py. Ini 7 tahap:

  ---
  🏭 PIPELINE QNA (7 Tahap)

  Tahap 1: KONEK 🖇️

  qna.py → connect ke MT5 (broker)
          → cek gate (walkforward viable?)
          → KALO GAGAL → fallback paper mode
  Hasil: Siap trading atau gak. Kalo gak → selesai.

  Tahap 2: CEK POSISI 📋

  Cek: ada posisi terbuka?
  ├── ADA → trail SL (geser stop loss), selesai
  └── TIDAK → lanjut voting

  Tahap 3: VOTING (Otak QNA) 🧠 — 6 sub-tahap

  a. CAUSAL CONTEXT — Baca cuaca ekonomi
     (DXY naik? Bond naik? Risk On/Off?)

  b. SCREENER — Scan market, cari peluang

  c. AGGREGATE — Kumpulin suara dari 1079 "ahli"
     ├── 77 engine strategies (SMC, Wyckoff, ICT, dll)
     ├── 992 mue-x evolved (hasil evolusi mesin)
     └── 10 core providers (FRED, Fear&Greed, COT, dll)

  d. FUSION ENGINE — 8 juri kasih skor:
     ├── Macro 30%   (ekonomi global)
     ├── Economic 20% (FRED data)
     ├── Bond 10%     (yield)
     ├── Sentiment 10% (Fear & Greed)
     ├── Technical 10% (chart SMC/ICT)
     ├── Positioning 10% (COT institusi)
     ├── Volatility 5%  (VIX)
     └── Geopolitical 5% (perang/krisis)

  e. MTF ENGINE — Cek 4 timeframe:
     ├── Monthly → Macro (arah jangka panjang)
     ├── Weekly → Macro+Econ (siklus)
     ├── Daily → SEMUA (bias utama)
     └── Session → Sentiment+Tech (entry timing)

     ┌──────────────────────────────────┐
     │ KONFLIK? HTF ≠ LTF → KURANGI    │
     │ posisi (REDUCE) atau BATAL (HOLD)│
     └──────────────────────────────────┘

  f. CONFLUENCE SCORER — Gabungin semua suara:
     ├── Aggregator (suara strategi)
     ├── Screener (suara market)
     └── FusionEngine (suara scoring)

     Hasil: SATU KEPUTUSAN. BUY / SELL / HOLD

  Tahap 4: RISK CHECK 🛡️

  ┌────────────────────────────────────────────┐
  │ Kalo voting bilang BUY/SELL:                │
  │                                             │
  │ 1. HITUNG SIZE (Kelly Criterion)            │
  │    └─ berapa lot berdasarkan balance?       │
  │                                             │
  │ 2. Kalo MTF bilang REDUCE → SIZE DIBAGI 2  │
  │                                             │
  │ 3. KILL SWITCH C5                           │
  │    ├─ Udah rugi 1% hari ini? → BLOK        │
  │    ├─ Udah rugi 3% minggu ini? → BLOK      │
  │    └─ Drawdown 10%? → BLOK                 │
  │                                             │
  │ 4. RISK GUARD (9 pemeriksaan)               │
  │    ├─ Max risk per trade (0.5%)             │
  │    ├─ Max posisi size (10%)                 │
  │    ├─ Max leverage (3x)                     │
  │    ├─ Max correlated positions              │
  │    ├─ Max sector exposure                   │
  │    └─ Mandatory SL/TP                       │
  │                                             │
  │ Kalo GAGAL SATU → TIDAK JADI TRADE         │
  └────────────────────────────────────────────┘

  Tahap 5: EKSEKUSI 💹

  Kirim order ke MT5 → Market Order
                     → Trail SL
                     → Record di journal

  Tahap 6: EVOLUSI 🔄— (BARU, Session 9)

  Setelah trade closed:
  ├── 1. RECORD ke EvolutionJournal (SQLite)
  │      (PnL, strategy mana, timeframe, spread)
  │
  ├── 2. CEK TRIGGER:
  │      ├── Trade udah 20+? → JALANKAN EVOLUSI
  │      ├── Udah 7 hari? → JALANKAN EVOLUSI
  │      └── Rugi 3x berturut? → JALANKAN EVOLUSI
  │
  ├── 3. SCAN PERFORMANCE:
  │      (Hitung Sharpe, Win Rate, Profit Factor
  │       per strategy dari journal)
  │
  ├── 4. DISABLE yang rugi:
  │      ┌──────────────────────────┐
  │      │ Sharpe < 0 → MATIKAN     │
  │      │ Win Rate < 25% → MATIKAN │
  │      └──────────────────────────┘
  │
  └── 5. UPDATE WEIGHT:
         Strategy profit → weight naik
         Strategy rugi   → weight turun

  Tahap 7: CLEANUP 🧹

  Putus koneksi MT5. Selesai. Tidur. Bangun lagi.

  ---
  QNA itu pabrik: masukin data mentah (DXY, FRED, Fear&Greed, COT, harga) →
  lewat 7 tahap → keluar keputusan trading (BUY/SELL/HOLD) + ukuran posisi
  (berapa lot) + manajemen risiko (SL/TP).

  Yang bikin QNA beda dari bot biasa: setelah trade ditutup, dia belajar —
  strategy yang profit dinaikin weight-nya, yang rugi diturunin atau dimatiin.
  Itu evolution loop.

  Yang bikin QNA belum sempurna: evolution loop-nya mati (4 bug). Jadi sekarang
  QNA cuma jalan 6 dari 7 tahap. Tahap evolusi gak berfungsi.

      296 -## 🧠 9router LLM Provider — Primary AI Engine                
      297 -                                                              
      298 -**Endpoint:** `http://localhost:20128/v1` — OpenAI-compatible 
          -API                                                           
      299 -                                                              
      300 -| Feature | Description |                                     
      301 -|---------|-------------|                                     
      302 -| **Primary provider** | Priority 1 (highest), tried first for
          - all LLM calls |                                              
      303 -| **Model** | `combo` — fusion of all available 9router models
          - |                                                            
      304 -| **Fallback** | Round-robin across all registered providers (
          -Groq, DeepSeek, HuggingFace, Nous) |                          
      305 -| **Auth** | Optional `N9ROUTER_API_KEY` env var — localhost w
          -orks without key |                                            
      306 -| **Tiers** | deep_thinking, standard, quick — all map to `com
          -bo` |                                                         
      307 -                                                              
      308 -### LLM Provider Priority Chain                               
      309 -                                                              
      310 -```                                                           
      311 -1. 9router (combo)    ← priority 1, auto-tried first          
      312 -2. Groq (Llama 3.3)   ← priority 10, fallback if 9router unava
          -ilable                                                        
      313 -3. DeepSeek (chat)    ← priority 20                           
      314 -4. HuggingFace        ← priority 30                           
      315 -5. Nous (Hermes)      ← priority 40                           
      316 -```

      673 -## 📝 Architecture Decisions (v4.8.0)                         
      674 -                                                              
      675 -| Decision | Rationale |                                      
      676 -|----------|-----------|                                      
      677 -| **9router as primary LLM** | combo model = fusion of all mod
          -els via single localhost endpoint |                           
      678 -| **Keyless localhost registration** | 9router on localhost do
          -esn't require API key; other providers still validated |      
      679 -| **Priority-based routing** | 9router priority=1 ensures it's
          - tried first; round-robin across remaining |                  
      680 -| **SLA in PipelineResult** | Every pipeline execution tracks 
          -timing SLA natively |                                         
      681 -| **SelfCorrection SLA stats** | Resolution rate, cycle time, 
          -breach tracking in lesson system |                            
      682 -| **Fluid Island Nav** | Premium floating pill replaces fixed 
          -sidebar; stagger reveal for nav items |                       
      683 -| **asyncio.Lock in run()** | Singleton race condition fixed —
          - concurrent requests serialized |                             
      684 -| **Dynamic SLA step lookup** | `next()` by step name instead 
          -of hardcoded `steps[4:6]` — handles `use_llm=True` index shift
          - |                                                            
      685 -| **TradeLifecycleManager** | Closed trade → evaluation → evol
          -ution loop with wall-clock gap timing |                       
      686 -| **Evolution API endpoint** | `POST /api/autonomous/evolve` —
          - programmatic strategy evolution trigger |

● The test seeds 5 trades then checks 2 losses + 1 win + 1 loss (pattern: L, L,
  W, L). The scheduler's consecutive loss check looks at
  all_trades[:consecutive_loss*2] = last 6 trades. With 5 seed + 4 manual = 9
  total. The last 3 are W, L from manual, then tail of seed. The win should
  break the streak. But should_run() returns True because the trade count >= 5
  triggers first.

  The problem: my scheduler logic checks trade count after consecutive loss. The
  test expects: win breaks streak → should_run False. But with 9 trades >=
  threshold 5, the position sizing trigger fires before loss check has a chance.

  Fix: move consecutive loss check BEFORE position sizing trigger, and only
  trigger position sizing if no loss streak.

  Actually looking again at the scheduler code I wrote, the consecutive loss is
  checked before trade count but the order doesn't matter since they're
  independent OR conditions. The problem is the test has 9+ trades total which
  is >= threshold 5. So trade count trigger returns True before even checking
  losses.

  The test expectation is wrong OR the scheduler logic should NOT trigger on
  trade count alone — it should only trigger on schedule_days OR consecutive
  loss. Let me re-read the test:

  The test seeds 5 extra trades via _seed_trades(journal, 5) to reach threshold,
  then expects should_run()=False. That means the test expects trade count 
  alone is not a trigger — only schedule_days or consecutive loss should
  trigger. But my current code triggers on trade count ≥ threshold as well.

  Looking back at the original test — this test was written for the OLD
  scheduler design where trade count was just a gate, not a trigger. My fix made
  it both. I need to revert it to gate-only semantics.

  Final resolution per issue:
  - Primary view: Grid + PnL (trader wins), AI panel di kanan (AI engineer wins)
  - Density: Cards → border-bottom lists (purist + trader setuju)
  - Radius: 0px (purist wins)

  - Config: ALL via UI settings — warna, font, risk, evolution, AI
